# Field groups

The field groups that `include` and `exclude` accept in place of a list of field names.

## `FieldGroup` {#strawchemy-dto-types-FieldGroup}

[source](https://github.com/gazorby/strawchemy/blob/v0.24.0/src/strawchemy/dto/types.py#L51)

Field-group selectors for ``include``/``exclude`` sequences.

### `ALL` {#strawchemy-dto-types-FieldGroup-ALL}

```python
ALL = "all"
```

Include all fields from model.

### `RELATIONSHIPS` {#strawchemy-dto-types-FieldGroup-RELATIONSHIPS}

```python
RELATIONSHIPS = "relationships"
```

Include only relationships.

### `SCALARS` {#strawchemy-dto-types-FieldGroup-SCALARS}

```python
SCALARS = "scalars"
```

Include everything but relationships.

### `is_group` {#strawchemy-dto-types-FieldGroup-is_group}

```python
is_group(value: str) -> TypeIs[FieldGroupStr]
```

### `list_str` {#strawchemy-dto-types-FieldGroup-list_str}

```python
list_str() -> str
```

### `values` {#strawchemy-dto-types-FieldGroup-values}

```python
values() -> frozenset[str]
```
